title: A place I haven't seen
goal: Say what hasn't happened with -mAdYk, and choose between -mAdYk, -mAýAn and -mAjAk.

intro.text: `-mAdYk` is the negative of `-An`: *okamadyk kitabym* (a book I haven't read), *görmedik ýerim* (a place I haven't seen), *tanamadyk adam* (someone you don't know). Compare *gelmedik* (who didn't come), *gelmeýän* (who doesn't come) and *gelmejek* (who won't come).

exercises.question: How do you say **a book I haven't read**?

why.1: *Okamajak kitabym* is **a book I won't read**.
why.2: *Okamaýan kitabym* is **a book I don't read**.

exercises.en: There are many places in Turkmenistan I haven't seen.

accept: medik

reject.why: *Gören ýerim* is a place I **have** seen. Not seen: *görmedik*.

accept: There is a man I do not know at the door.
A man I do not know is standing at the door.
A stranger is standing at the door.
There is a stranger at the door.
Someone I do not know is standing at the door.
There is someone I do not know at the door.

exercises.prompt: I called the guests who didn't come.
accept: Men gelmedik myhmanlara jaň etdim.
Gelmedik myhmanlara jaň etdim.

reject.why: *Gelmejek* is **who won't come**. They didn't come: *gelmedik*.
*Gelmeýän* is **who aren't coming**. They didn't come: *gelmedik*.

exercises.explain: *gelmedik myhmanlar* (the guests who didn't come) + the dative after *jaň etmek*.

exercises.question: Which is **a film we haven't seen yet**?

accept: This is a book I have not read yet.
This is a book I have not read.
This is the book I have not read yet.
I have not read this book yet.

exercises.prompt: I want to see the towns I haven't seen.
accept: Görmedik şäherlerimi görmek isleýärin.

exercises.en: Call the guests who didn't come!

accept: medik

reject.why: *Gelmejek* is **who won't come**. They didn't come: *gelmedik*.

accept: Do not open the door to people you do not know!
Do not open the door to strangers!
Never open the door to strangers!

exercises.question: Which word means **who didn't come**?

why.2: *Gelmeýän*: who doesn't come, who isn't coming.

exercises.explain: `-mAdYk` is the negative of `-An`: what didn't happen.

exercises.prompt: The town we're going to visit is wonderful.
accept: Gitjek şäherimiz ajaýyp.
Biziň gitjek şäherimiz ajaýyp.
(Biziň) barjak şäherimiz ajaýyp.

reject.why: *Giden* is **that we went to**. Not yet: *gitjek*.

exercises.explain: *gitjek şäher* (the town … will go to) + **our**: *gitjek şäherimiz*.
